groups.defect: The device ID is written to the local cache before CreateOrUpdateDevice runs and is never removed when that call fails (for example with ErrDeviceLimitReached). A retry then hits the cache fast path, skips the database limit check and authenticates, which bypasses the device limit.

answer.reasoning: Both suggestions describe the same defect in the same file, impl.go, inside the same tagging flow. The cache entry is set before the store call and stays in place when the call fails, so a rejected device gets past the limit on its next request. Both propose the same fix: fill the cache only after a successful write, or remove the entry on error. One points at the new error return (lines 144-147) and the other at the cache-setting logic (lines 80-95). Both line ranges are in the same file and the same code path, and one edit fixes both, so the kind is same_location rather than cross_location. Each member reports only this one defect, so a unified comment is not needed.
